draft.subject: Next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Glad Tariq could close the loop on your bulk import question — teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, so you don't have to add people one by one.

You've got your first project set up and an invite out, which is a good start. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting your team working in there together is usually where Wrenfield starts to pay off.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your next step with you.

Best,
Priya
